rule: the days before today are records read off the factory's own systems — what was filled, and what left the gate. Nothing on them was worked out by the computer, and the two ways of counting what was filled are never added together.

days.made_mes_label: filled, per the machine log — it sees about two-thirds of the plant
days.made_booked_label: booked into the godown — a day's booking can land a day after the filling it books

basis.made_mes: MES view only — roughly two-thirds of the plant. About a third of output never appears as a run (Aug: 1.44 M L of MES runs vs ~2.12 M L actual). Use it for line mix and pace, not for plant quantity.
basis.made_booked: booked_today is goods receipts into BH-PF dated today. The receipt date lags the production date by 0-1 day and varies by SKU — this is production BOOKED, not 'produced today'. Read out of BH-PF only — the same room the live 'booked today' tile reads.
basis.billed_out: A/R invoice lines going OUT of BH-PF only, litres from the pack size in the item name. A FLOOR: BH-BT is not read here, and a name that does not parse adds 0 L.
basis.dispatched: gate rows with status DISPATCHED, all three books, placed on the day of their gate-out date. Oil is the JIVO_OIL rows only; trucks are de-duplicated on the vehicle, which appears once per company.
basis.sunday: a Sunday is a closed day, but its record is never zeroed to match — if the plant filled anything it is shown.
basis.settling: a day is read again every hour until it is 2 days old and every read of it came back whole; after that it is kept as it stands.

notes: the machine log and the goods receipts are the same production counted two ways — never add them together.
